formCss:
<style>
.login-background {
  color-scheme: light;
  --background: 250 100% 98%;
  --foreground: 250 20% 14%;
  --card: 0 0% 100%;
  --card-foreground: 250 20% 14%;
  --muted: 250 40% 96%;
  --muted-foreground: 250 8% 40%;
  --accent: 250 40% 95%;
  --accent-foreground: 250 20% 14%;
  --border: 250 30% 90%;
  --input: 250 25% 86%;
  font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
}
.login-background {
  background: radial-gradient(at 50% -5%, color-mix(in srgb, {{accentColor}} 30%, transparent) 0%, transparent 50%), radial-gradient(at 10% 20%, #ffd3e6 0%, transparent 45%), radial-gradient(at 90% 15%, #c7e2ff 0%, transparent 45%), radial-gradient(at 82% 88%, #d8c7ff 0%, transparent 50%), radial-gradient(at 15% 90%, #c6f4e2 0%, transparent 45%), #f6f4ff;
}
.login-content > div {
  max-width: 430px;
}
.login-panel {
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.75);
  border-radius: 24px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.55);
  box-shadow: 0 24px 64px -12px rgba(80, 60, 160, 0.25);
  backdrop-filter: blur(24px) saturate(160%);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(24px) saturate(160%);
}
.signin-methods > div {
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8);
  border-radius: 12px;
}
.signin-methods [role='tab'][data-state='active'] {
  border-radius: 9px;
  background: #ffffff !important;
}
.login-form label {
  color: #4a4560;
  font-weight: 500;
}
.login-form input:not([type='checkbox']):not([type='radio']) {
  height: 46px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9);
  border-radius: 12px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.72);
  font-size: 15px;
  box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(60, 40, 120, 0.06);
}
.login-form input:not([type='checkbox']):not([type='radio']):focus {
  border-color: {{accentColor}};
  background: #ffffff;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px color-mix(in srgb, {{accentColor}} 20%, transparent);
}
.login-form [role='checkbox'] {
  border-radius: 5px;
}
.login-form [role='checkbox'][data-state='checked'] {
  background: {{accentColor}};
  border-color: {{accentColor}};
  color: #ffffff;
}
.login-form a {
  color: {{accentColor}};
  font-weight: 500;
}
.login-form .login-button {
  height: 46px;
  border-radius: 12px;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, {{accentColor}} 0%, color-mix(in srgb, {{accentColor}} 55%, #ec4899) 100%);
  color: #ffffff;
  font-size: 15px;
  font-weight: 600;
  box-shadow: 0 10px 24px -8px color-mix(in srgb, {{accentColor}} 60%, transparent);
}
.login-form .login-button:hover {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, {{accentColor}} 0%, color-mix(in srgb, {{accentColor}} 55%, #ec4899) 100%);
  opacity: 0.92;
}
#footer {
  color: #6b6580;
}
.login-form .login-forget-password {
  width: 100%;
}
</style>
